newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian share index higher in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian share index higher in brisk trade.

text.p: The Nigerian share index closed higher after brisk Tuesday trade on the Nigerian stock exchange, with interest in minor shares as well as the dominant blue chips.
The all-share index closed at 6,100.67 from 6,095.67 on Monday.
Ashaka Cement rose 20 kobo to 14.55 naira, while National Oil advanced 12 kobo to 26.52 naira.
Flour Mills Nigeria closed 12 kobo higher at 11.28 naira. Cadbury and Union Dicon Salt were both 10 kobo higher at 22.85 naira and 31 naira respectively.

A number of smaller companies rose by the maximum five percent allowed in one day. They included Lion Bank up two kobo at 54 kobo. Roads Nigeria, a construction firm was one kobo up at 24 kobo, with heavy equipment dealers Blackwood Hodge gaining three kobo to 67 kobo.
Biggest loser was Nigerian Breweries, closing two kobo down at 13.78 naira with large volumes still flooding the market.
Packaging firms CMB and Delta Glass both ended two kobo lower at 4.64 naira and 6.28 naira respectively. First Aluminium dropped one kobo to 5.39 naira.
